name: get_events
description: Query the deduped news event graph by theme, source, category and time window. Returns events (many articles about one happening collapsed into one), each with a corroboration count and confidence score. This is the primary tool — prefer it over raw articles. The corpus spans 260+ global outlets and a five-year archive (history visible depends on tier).

arguments.name: q
arguments.desc: Free-text theme/keyword to match on headline + summary

arguments.name: semantic
arguments.desc: Rank by meaning (embedding similarity) instead of keyword match — requires q; better for concepts ('monetary easing') than exact strings

arguments.name: category
arguments.desc: Source category: crypto, tradfi, business, tech, politics, world, science, health, energy or sports

arguments.name: from
arguments.desc: Only events active on/after this date. ISO 8601 date/time, e.g. 2026-07-01 or 2026-07-01T00:00:00Z

arguments.name: to
arguments.desc: Only events active on/before this date. ISO 8601 date/time, e.g. 2026-07-01 or 2026-07-01T00:00:00Z

name: get_event
description: Fetch a single event by id, including every corroborating article (source, url, timestamp).

name: search_articles
description: Search raw articles (not collapsed into events). Use when you want the underlying items or need per-outlet coverage rather than deduped happenings.

arguments.name: category
arguments.desc: Source category: crypto, tradfi, business, tech, politics, world, science, health, energy or sports

name: list_sources
description: List all news sources Newsflash tracks, with categories and live article counts.

name: corpus_stats
description: Corpus size and freshness: source / article / event counts and the latest article timestamp.
